A fell by 10
B fell by 11
C increased by 10
D increased by 30

B governments’ imposition of trade restrictions

D transport costs outweighing any comparative advantage

D value of telecommunications services that are imported

B introducing quotas on imports
C raising tariffs on imports
D subsidising exports
